mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% and rises by more than 0.5 percentage points in a single month, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and FEDFUNDS rise > 0.5pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window remains above 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers corporate earnings concerns and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a rising labor force participation rate (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM) signals a tight labor market that fuels wage inflation and corporate cost pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past quarter signals robust economic activity and corporate profitability, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO has increased over the prior quarter, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 and declines by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals a manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window remains above 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%), a decline in consumer spending (RSAFS decline > 0.5% MoM) signals a weakening in real demand that pressures corporate margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.
